# MATCH 3D v20 — third-party attribution

## CesiumMan

Original model: [CesiumMan in Khronos glTF Sample Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CesiumMan), © 2017 Cesium, licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Original animation and skin retained. The glTF was modified to remove image/texture references, including the Cesium logo/trademark; the character uses a neutral material and is recolored in the game. The source binary mesh/animation buffer is unchanged. This is a generic animated humanoid, not a rugby-specific motion-capture asset.

## Three.js GLTFLoader

Based on Three.js release r149 `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, © Three.js authors, under the [MIT License](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r149/LICENSE). Adapted to use the local global `THREE` and a limited triangle-only helper. Other primitive modes are not supported by this adaptation.

Both files are stored locally. No CDN or network asset is required for gameplay.
